description.zh:
持续时间（单位：分钟），一次定时弹性任务持续的时间。

> 入参不少于15分钟。
description.en:
The duration of each scheduled scaling task. Unit: minutes.

>  The value of this parameter must be greater than or equal to 15.

description.zh:
启用或禁用定时任务策略。取值范围如下：

- **true**：启用。
- **false**：禁用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the scheduled scaling rule. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

description.zh:
开始执行定时策略时间。

如果是单次调度的策略类型，需要保证开始执行时间晚于当前时间30分钟以上。



><notice>为避免服务端不停地执行升配、降配任务，不同定时任务之间的时间间隔要至少大于 60 分钟。></notice>
description.en:
The time when the scheduled scaling task is executed.

If you set ScheduleType to at, make sure that the value of this parameter is at least 30 minutes later than the current point in time.

><notice>To prevent the broker from repeatedly executing instance upgrade and downgrade tasks, make sure that the interval between two consecutive scheduled scaling tasks is at least 60 minutes.></notice>
The ID of the region where the instance resides.

description.zh:
当 ScheduleType 为 repeat 时则需要填写参数，枚举值为
      <li> Daily：每天定时调度。
      <li> Weekly：每周定时调度。
description.en:
The frequency to execute the scheduled scaling task. This parameter is required only if you set ScheduleType to repeat. Valid values:

*   Daily: The scheduled scaling task is executed every day.

*   Weekly: The scheduled scaling task is executed every week.

description.zh:
定时弹性预留生产规格（单位：MB/s）。

> ReservedPubFlow 和 ReservedSubFlow 入参必须至少有一个高于当前规格。
description.en:
The reserved production capacity for scheduled scaling. Unit: MB/s.

>  You must specify a higher value than the instance specification for at least one of ReservedPubFlow and ReservedSubFlow.

description.zh:
定时弹性预留消费规格（单位：MB/s）。
> ReservedSubFlow 和 ReservedPubFlow 入参必须至少有一个高于当前规格。
description.en:
The reserved consumption capacity for scheduled scaling. Unit: MB/s.

>  You must specify a higher value than the instance specification for at least one of ReservedPubFlow and ReservedSubFlow.

description.zh:
定时策略规则名称。

> 不可以与同实例其他规则名称重复。
description.en:
The name of the scheduled scaling rule.

>  The name of the scheduled scaling rule cannot be the same as the names of other rules for the instance.

description.zh:
定时类型。取值如下：

- at ：只调度一次。

-  repeat：重复调度。
description.en:
The type of the scheduled scaling task. Valid values:

*   at: The scheduled scaling task is executed only once.
*   repeat: The scheduled scaling task is repeatedly executed.
The time zone in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

description.zh: 每周的类型。支持多日重复执行。
description.en: The day on which the scheduled scaling task is executed every week. You can specify multiple days.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka create-scheduled-scaling-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_serverless-cn-vxxxxxxxx --rule-name test --reserved-pub-flow 120 --reserved-sub-flow 120 --schedule-type at --duration-minutes 60 --time-zone GMT+8 --first-scheduled-time 1714467540000 --enable true --repeat-type Weekly --weekly-types Monday --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alikafka CreateScheduledScalingRule --region cn-hangzhou --ScheduleType at --ReservedPubFlow 120 --ReservedSubFlow 120 --TimeZone 'GMT+8' --InstanceId 'alikafka_serverless-cn-vxxxxxxxx' --DurationMinutes 60 --FirstScheduledTime 1714467540000 --Enable true --RepeatType Weekly --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --WeeklyTypes '["Monday"]' --RuleName test
